messages:
maria (Design): dropping in new mock for the rollout card — trying a compact "version ring" to show history + an inline 'partial release' control. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/YYYY/rollout-compact

omar (Product): Nice. Quick callouts before design review: 1) Terminology: 'Partial release' vs 'Canary' — which should surface in product docs? 2) Rollback affordance: button vs action menu?

li (Eng): On impl: action menu is easier for permission gating (only show rollback to specific roles). Button is faster in the UI but needs confirmation modal. Also ring+scroller combo will need virtualization for accounts with lots of versions.

riley (Accessibility): A11y initial run: ring needs focusable items; ensure each version node gets an accessible name like "version 2026-03-10 commit abc123". Contrast for the inline 'partial release' chip is borderline when used on dark backgrounds. Also the confirmation modal must trap focus and return focus on close.

maria (Design): Thanks. Two microcopy variants for the control label: 1) "Partial release" (friendly), 2) "Canary (partial release)" (discovery). Which do we prefer in the compact UI where space is tight?

omar (Product): Leaning toward "Partial release" as primary. Add a small info icon that says "also called canary" so power users see it. For rollback copy: we need to make the consequences explicit. Proposed: "Rollback to previous stable — this will reassign traffic and queue a redeploy. Undo available for 5 minutes." Thoughts?

li (Eng): We can keep undo for 5 minutes by retaining rollback records in Redis for that window; cost is minimal. But note: if a new deploy happens within those 5 minutes the undo semantics get murky. We should show the exact window in the UI and disable undo after another deploy.

riley (Accessibility): Quick ARIA suggestion for the partial release slider: aria-label="partial release percentage", aria-valuemin="0", aria-valuemax="100", step="0.5", and expose aria-valuetext with localized string like "12.5 percent". Also add role="list" for the version ring and role="listitem" for each node to help screen reader navigation.

maria (Design): I'll add a compact tooltip pattern (hover/focus) that expands to show the longer explanation and the commit message preview when space permits. For the rollback modal copy variants: short vs detailed. Short: "Rollback to previous stable". Detailed: "Rollback to previous stable version. Traffic will switch back immediately. You can undo within 5 minutes unless a new deploy occurs." Which should be default?

omar (Product): Default to detailed in the modal body, short label on the action. Engineers can collapse the body if we need smaller modals. Also include a small changelog link in the modal for context.

li (Eng): Technical: changelog link should be an opt-in fetch to avoid inflating timeline responses. We'll fetch metadata when the modal opens. For the ring virtualization, recommend windowing + prefetch for adjacent nodes to keep scrolling smooth.

riley (Accessibility): One more: animated transitions for the ring should respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also ensure the info icon is keyboard focusable and has aria-describedby referencing the tooltip content.

maria (Design): Updated artboards will: - show 'Partial release' label by default + compact 'canary' hint - inline slider with 0.5% ticks in the expanded view - rollback action in an overflow menu, which triggers a confirm modal with detailed copy + undo timer - version ring uses virtualization with focusable nodes and commit preview on focus

deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.ai/rollout-compact (staging)

omar (Product): Thanks all. Can you tag me when the updated figma and the a11y checklist are posted? I'll schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow to finalize retention numbers and copy.

maria (Design): Will do — posting updates now and pinging @omar and @riley when ready. :sparkles:
